workstream: W14 — independent second-annotator overlap pass + agreement measurement (TA verification + paddle ownership)
baseline: Every gold label single-annotator (TA cases verified only by devin-visual-v2-wave-a; ownership verdicts only by devin-visual-v2-wave-a). Inter-annotator agreement unmeasured — label reliability unknown, the top credibility gap.
candidate: Blind second-annotator overlap layer by devin-visual-overlap-w14: 12 TA cases (stratified verdict-blind from the 29 wave-a-verified dev cases) re-rendered and re-judged from frames only; 12 ownership frames (31 boxes, development-role cases only) re-judged from retained review PNGs. Verdicts frozen to disk BEFORE reading any primary verdict. Primary label files untouched.

taAgreement.caveat: n=12 with 11/12 primary correct-lock: kappa prevalence-dominated, approx SE 0.36 — treat as directional only
taAgreement.disagreementNature: BOTH definitional, ZERO perceptual: non-player region occupants (phone-filming staffer ta-44c0c451500c-s1w0-p6, barrier spectator ta-960a1a200d6d-s8w0-p1) — primary verifies them as adversarial region-occupant cases, W14 read them as wrong-lock/reject. Identical scene descriptions on both sides.

ownershipAgreement.caveat: boxes clustered in 12 frames / 3 videos — effective n < 31; nominal SE 0.12 understates uncertainty
ownershipAgreement.disagreementNature: 1 genuine perception miss by single-frame review (floor paddle judged held, rally2@3372 box1 — primary's cross-frame static-object evidence decisive), 2 threshold/evidence-standard splits on motion blur (rally2@2204 box2, rally2@2604 box1). All 3 in afn-sasebo-rally2 (blur + clutter); wm-volley-02 and rally1 were 100% agreement including both ambiguous calls.

measured.blindnessProtocol: followed: worklist built from ids/frame-paths only → frames viewed → verdicts written and frozen (ta-overlap.json, ownership-overlap.json) → primary verdicts read → agreement computed

filesChanged: datasets/ta-bench/review/<12 caseId>.png (re-rendered via pnpm lab:ta-bench render — render artifacts only, no label files touched)
recommendation: Ownership labels are reliable enough to scale ONCE the review tool shows temporal context: mandate ±1-2 adjacent frames (or 3-frame strips from lab:own propose), a static-object ledger (floor paddles / net-tape / banners are named traps), a numeric center-offset rule for blurred paddles (~0.03-0.05 norm), and hand-continuity as the bar for 'other'. TA verification needs its operational definition WRITTEN before more annotation: verified = region→person correspondence regardless of player status, plus a mandatory bystander_target situation tag (both TA disagreements were this one undefined rule, not perception). Add a 3-frame scrub rule for crowd-heavy regions and per-verdict confidence fields to both schemas. Adjudication of the 5 flagged items stays with commander — nothing was overwritten.
risks: Small n: TA kappa 0.44±0.36 is directional, not conclusive; 12 ownership frames cluster in 3 videos so agreement may not transfer to new footage
Both annotators are Devin-family visual passes — shared failure modes (e.g., both fooled by the same render limitation) would inflate agreement vs a human pair

Primary TA notes for the 2 disagreement cases show intent (adversarial bystander cases), but if downstream lock-correct metrics do not slice bystander_target cases, product numbers inherit a silent flattery bias
Ownership overlap deliberately excluded held-out material (wm-dink-01, afn-vic-rally1) — agreement on held-out-style footage remains unmeasured by design
Single mid-frame TA rendering caps achievable verification quality (faead-s3w5-p2 verified at 0.55 confidence by W14); scrub-based re-verification may flip edge cases
